encounters.name: Backstage
encounters.desc: Behind the scenery, where the props wait. The understudy is rehearsing your part.
encounters.intro: You weren't supposed to come back here.

encounters.name: The Previous Party
encounters.desc: The miniatures of the last party to sit at this table. They have been waiting for a rematch.
encounters.intro: You remember them? No. But they remember the table.

encounters.name: The Caller's Hand
encounters.desc: His own dice, his own lawyer, two of his faces. A private game.
encounters.intro: Just between us. Nobody needs to know.

events.title: The Time Clock
events.text: A time clock and a rack of cards with your names on them. 'Clock in. Everybody clocks in.'

options.label: Clock in
options.result: Wages, paid in advance. A new rule: Overtime.

check.pass_text: Somebody else's wages. Somebody else's experience.
check.fail_text: The Foreman docks you. Next fight your party starts rooted.

options.label: Smash the clock
options.result: A pocket watch falls out of it. The line stops. Somebody important is coming. Next fight is an elite.

events.title: The Prospector
events.text: An old prospector with a pan full of gravel. 'Gold in these hills. Gold in everything, if you look hard enough.'

options.label: Buy his claim (40 gold)
options.result: The claim comes with a jar he keeps the gold dust in.

options.label: Ask about the machines
options.result: He knows where they sleep.

events.title: Spare Parts
events.text: A bin of spare parts: gears, valves, a hand that still twitches.

options.label: Bolt something on
options.result: Sturdier. Clunkier.

options.label: Take the twitching hand
options.result: It wants to do things twice.

options.label: Sell the scrap
options.result: The tinkers pay by the pound.

events.title: The Runaway Cart
events.text: A mine cart rattles toward you down the rails, full of ore, with nobody driving.

check.pass_text: A wild ride. Everyone arrives early and rich.
You stop it dead. Your ribs complain. The ore is yours.

events.title: The Strike
events.text: Machines standing in a silent picket line. A sign: NO MORE SHIFTS. The Foreman is shouting at them.

options.label: Join the picket
options.result: The machines remember who stood with them. Next fight, enemies have 20% less HP.

options.label: Break the strike
options.result: The Foreman pays well. The machines remember you too. Next fight is an elite.

events.title: The Canary
events.text: A canary in a cage, very still, at the mouth of a mine. The air smells of almonds.

options.label: Go in anyway
options.result: You find what killed the canary. And what it was guarding.

options.label: Take the cage
options.result: Under the cage, two antidotes. Somebody planned ahead.

events.title: Mechanical Fortune
events.text: A fortune-telling machine in a glass box. INSERT COIN. Its painted eyes follow you.

rows.text: YOU WILL FIND WHAT YOU LOST.

options.label: Break the glass
options.result: Coins spill out. The machine says one last thing. Next fight your party starts cursed.

events.title: The Furnace Door
events.text: A furnace that never goes out. The Foreman offers you a shovel. 'Feed it, and it'll feed you.'

options.label: Feed it a relic
options.result: It melts. Every hero's best card is reforged.

options.label: Feed it gold (30)
options.result: Hot work. Next fight your party starts empowered.

options.label: Warm your hands
options.result: Just that.

events.title: The Inventor
events.text: An inventor with a contraption that may be a weapon, a stove, or a third thing. 'Try it! Please. Nobody ever tries it.'

options.label: Buy it (35 gold)
options.result: Two thunderstones. He's thrilled.

options.label: Encourage him
options.result: He cries a little. So do you.

events.title: The Saloon
events.text: A saloon with one customer, a piano that plays itself, and a bartender made of brass.

options.label: Buy a round (20 gold)
options.result: Strong stuff. Everyone feels better and slightly worse.

check.pass_text: You take his money. He seems relieved.
check.fail_text: He takes yours. He seems sorry about it.

options.label: Hire the piano player
options.result: The piano stops playing itself. Someone stands up from behind it.

events.title: The Cog Altar
events.text: The machines have built an altar out of gears. They pray to it. It turns.

options.label: Pray with them
options.result: Next fight your party starts guarded.

options.label: Steal a gear
options.result: The machines see. Next fight your party starts marked.

check.pass_text: The altar stops. Next fight the machines are dispirited (15% less HP).

events.title: The Telegraph Office
events.text: A telegraph clattering on its own. The operator hands you a slip: it's addressed to your party.

options.label: Read it
options.result: STOP. THE WAY AHEAD IS AS FOLLOWS. STOP.

options.label: Send a reply
options.result: A parcel arrives almost immediately.

options.label: Cut the wire
options.result: Somewhere, a rule stops being transmitted.

events.title: A Crate of Dynamite
events.text: A crate stencilled DANGER. The sticks inside are sweating.

check.pass_text: Two sticks, wrapped in a handkerchief.
check.fail_text: One of them was very sweaty.

options.label: Blow the tunnel ahead
options.result: A lot of the enemy under a lot of rock. Next fight, 25% less HP.

events.title: The Engineer's Widow
events.text: A widow polishing a machine shaped like her husband. 'He's in there somewhere. Would you help me wind him?'

options.label: Help her wind him
options.result: He takes one step, salutes, and stops. She gives you a cut-out of him to keep.

options.label: Take his parts
options.result: She doesn't stop you. She just watches.

options.label: Sit with her
options.result: She makes tea. It is very good tea.

events.title: The Wheel of Fortune
events.text: A great iron wheel with prizes painted on the segments. 'Spin it! Everyone wins something!'

check.fail_text: He adds a rule about ties.

events.title: The Brass Band
events.text: A band of brass automatons playing a march for nobody. They stop when they see you, and wait.

options.label: Ask for a march
options.result: Next fight your party starts hasted and blessed.

options.label: Ask for a dirge
options.result: Next fight the enemy starts frightened.

options.label: Steal a trumpet
options.result: Not a trumpet, it turns out. A mask that was hanging inside it.

events.title: The Unpainted Page
events.text: Here the board is bare wood and pencil lines. The Understudy is sketching something that looks like your party.

options.label: Let it finish the sketch
options.result: You feel more defined. Some details are wrong.

options.label: Take the pencil
options.result: There's an eraser on the other end.

check.pass_text: You draw a relic. It becomes one.
check.fail_text: You draw something you can't stop looking at.

events.title: The Box Lid
events.text: You've reached the edge of the board. Beyond it is the lid of the game box, enormous, with the title on it. It's a different game.

options.label: Read the rules on the back
options.result: Different rules. You remember some of them.

rows.text: Something packed away for a reason.

events.title: The Rewrite
events.text: The Caller crosses out a paragraph of the campaign. 'I don't like how this bit went. Shall I do it again?'

options.label: Yes, redo it
options.result: The last few pages never happened, mostly. One rule did.

options.label: No, keep it
options.result: He looks at you for a long time. 'Very well. You earned it.'

options.label: Ask to rewrite something yourself
options.result: He hands you the pen. It's heavier than it looks. Next fight, your party starts marked.

events.title: Stand-Ins
events.text: Four grey miniatures in your poses. 'In case you don't make it,' the Understudy explains. 'Nothing personal.'

options.label: Break them
options.result: Next fight your party starts empowered.

options.label: Keep one
options.result: It stands up. It has your face. It's on your side, for now.

options.label: Take their paint
options.result: A fresh coat for everyone.

events.title: The Die That Watches
events.text: An enormous die stands on one corner, impossibly. Every face shows a different number of eyes.

rows.text: One eye. It blinks at you.

check.pass_text: It answers, in numbers. Everyone understands a little more.
check.fail_text: It answers. You wish it hadn't.

events.title: The Cast List
events.text: A cast list pinned to the edge of the world. Your heroes are on it. Next to two of the names, in pencil: (understudy).

options.label: Rub out the pencil
options.result: Leading roles again.

options.label: Add your own name
options.result: The Caller notices. A new rule appears below your name.

events.title: Tea Break
events.text: The Night Nurse sets down a tray at the edge of the board. 'Last tea break. After this it's straight through.'

options.label: Drink up
options.result: The last good cup of tea in the campaign.

options.label: Bandage up
options.result: Injuries seen to. A spare bottle of salts.

options.label: Ask her what's next
options.result: She tells you. Next fight your party starts warded.

events.title: The Masks
events.text: A rack of the Caller's masks, out here at the end of the table. He isn't wearing one. 'Go on. Try one.'

options.label: Try the Receptionist
options.result: You feel expected. Hard to get rid of.

options.label: Try the Auctioneer
options.result: You sell yourself a rule. Good price.

options.label: Try the empty one
options.result: There's nobody behind it. There's nobody behind it.

events.title: Closing-Down Sale
events.text: The prize counter, at the end of everything. 'EVERYTHING MUST GO.' She means it.

options.label: Browse
options.result: Final reductions.

options.label: Take what's left
options.result: She doesn't stop you. Nothing matters now, she says.

options.label: Thank her
options.result: She looks surprised. Nobody thanks the prize counter.

events.title: A Footnote
events.text: A tiny footnote at the bottom of the page, in the Caller's hand: *The heroes may skip the next fight, at a cost.

options.label: Skip it (lose a relic)
options.result: He crosses out the next fight. And something of yours.

options.label: Skip it (lose a hero's level of experience)
options.result: He takes it out of your hide instead.

options.label: Ignore footnotes
options.result: Nobody reads footnotes. He sighs.

events.title: The Curtain
events.text: A red curtain hangs across the end of the table. Behind it, something is waiting to come on.

check.pass_text: You see the ending. It could go either way. Next fight, your party starts inspired.

options.label: Pull it down
options.result: The understudy was standing right behind it.

options.label: Wait for your cue
options.result: Your cue comes. Everyone is rested.

events.title: A Door Behind the Scenery
events.text: A painted door that opens. Backstage, the understudy is learning your lines from a script with your names in it.

options.label: Confront it
options.result: It looks up. It has your face.

check.pass_text: You know how this ends. Mostly.

events.title: Initials in the Wood
events.text: Carved into the board: four sets of initials. The previous party. Their miniatures are standing in the margin, facing you.

options.label: Challenge them
options.result: They raise their weapons. They've been waiting a long time.

options.label: Add your own initials
options.result: You belong to the table now. That isn't entirely good news.

options.label: Leave them be
options.result: They nod as you pass.

events.title: A Private Game
events.text: The Caller puts a finger to the place his lips would be. 'Just between us. A side game. High stakes.'

options.label: Play
options.result: He deals you in. He takes the gold off the table up front, as your stake. Win it back.

options.label: Ask about the hall
options.result: He tells you something. You will find it later, in the hall, on a tape.

events.title: Inside the Cage
events.text: For a moment the page shows the inside of a bingo cage. Numbered balls tumble around you. One of them has your party's number.

check.pass_text: You catch it. Everyone learns something.
check.fail_text: The balls are heavier than they look.

options.label: Catch somebody else's
options.result: A prize and a rule. Somebody else is going to be very confused.

options.label: Wait to be called
options.result: You are called. You come back rested.

events.title: The Reception Desk
events.text: The page shows the hall's reception desk. The drawer marked FALLEN is open. One of your dead is sitting on the desk, swinging their legs.

options.label: Bring them back
options.result: Somebody sits down at the table. Not quite the same somebody.

options.label: Ask them what they saw
options.result: They tell you. You don't sleep well.

options.label: Close the drawer
options.result: It closes softly.

events.title: The Clock at Seven
events.text: The hall clock, stopped at seven, is lying on the page. The hands can be moved.

options.label: Move them forward
options.result: Time passes. You are older and wiser and a little worn.

options.label: Move them back
options.result: As if nothing happened. Nearly. He noticed.

options.label: Leave it at seven
options.result: You take the watch from its back. It has also stopped at seven.
